about_the_game:
Static Signal is an open-world 'action' horror game where Zach, a former worker at Smartware Inc., must venture into his old office building to finish up some tasks they couldn't hire anyone else to do. However, Zach soon realizes that all his coworkers are dead, and a malicious entity is at the root of it. One that desires to reshape the world into a robotic dystopia. The end of the world is nigh, but you have a chance to stop it before it's too late.

GAMEPLAY - In Static Signal, adventure is your friend. Explore various floors in Smartware Inc., and the fractures of reality created by the Intelligence Core. Complete puzzles to progress through your surroundings, and hide from the various threats that surround you. Learn about the nightmares that occurred there, both the metaphorical and physical ones, using notes found throughout the locations. Return to previous location to pick up on new quests, and even unlock new endings to the horrors of STATIC SIGNAL.

This entire experience was created by one individual, SlenderBandit.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600, Core i5 6600K
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Static Signal is an open world 'action' horror game. Venture through your old office building and even reality as a malicious entity plans to reshape the world into a nightmare, but you can stop it before it's too late. Will you waste your time away, or will you save everyone from extinction?
